title: Characterizations of Conditional Mutual Independence: Equivalence and Implication
summary: Conditional independence, and more generally conditional mutual independence, are central notions in probability theory. In their general forms, they include functional dependence as a special case. In this paper, we tackle two fundamental problems related to conditional mutual independence. Let $K$ and $K'$ be two conditional mutual independncies (CMIs) defined on a finite set of discrete random variables.
